content: We can see that the sentence representation $S_{A_w}$ is a weighted average of the hidden states. fig:bilstminneratt provides a schematic view of the BiLSTM attention, where we can account the attention described in eq:att as a two layer model with a dense layer ( $d_a$ units) followed by another dense that predicts $\alpha _t$ (single unit).
